ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform matching micro-entrepreneurs and informal sector workers with localized upskilling micro-tasks and gig opportunities.
ideas.problem_statement: SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth
ideas.title: MicroSkill-Match
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets SDG 8 with measurable metrics on job matching rates, fitting the exact UN sustainable development goals outlined in the event criteria.

ideas.pitch: An automated computer vision tool that inspects public infrastructure assets using smartphone imagery to predict maintenance needs for local municipalities.
ideas.title: InfraAudit-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with SDG 9 infrastructure goals and leverages a proven computer vision inspection pattern that has historically won industrial hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A vibe-coded supply chain optimization dashboard that helps local manufacturing SMEs track and reduce their carbon footprint and logistics inefficiencies.
ideas.title: SupplyChain-Carbon-Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rapid vibe-coding with enterprise resource optimization, directly appealing to judges looking for scalable real-world industry impact.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile app leveraging lightweight image classification to help smallholder farmers diagnose crop diseases instantly and access local market prices.
ideas.problem_statement: SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth
ideas.title: AgriYield-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles economic growth for agricultural workers and builds on a proven, award-winning social impact architecture from international UN hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An energy anomaly detection and reduction assistant for small businesses and co-working spaces to optimize utility usage and lower operating overhead.
ideas.problem_statement: SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth
ideas.title: EcoGrid-SME
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on cost-saving economic viability for small businesses, combining tangible financial metrics with environmental sustainability.
